C0549.title: Beijing Woman Detained for Malicious Swap-and-Return Fraud
C0549.summary: A woman in Beijing exploited e-commerce platform loopholes to carry out a 'zero-dollar purchase' scheme by maliciously swapping items and returning them for refunds, involving nearly 100 orders before being detained by police on criminal charges. The case reveals a novel criminal tactic of defrauding refunds through product substitution.
